## Checks

- [ ] `flutter analyze` is clean (root, and `example/` if touched)
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] For `lib/src/gpu/` or shader changes: ran an `example/` app on a real
      device/simulator and visually confirmed (headless tests can't exercise
      the GPU path — see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` / docs if this is user-facing
